name: Wincent Wolf
review:
Two flashy Vegas players, Wincent Wolf and Scarlett Fox, on 20 lines – with cheeky W-marked aces.

Free spins bring sticky wilds that give the bonus real staying power, and a Wheel of Fortune adds extra outcomes. Medium-high volatility, a 10,000x max and 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 150 spins. Full of character and nicely balanced.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
